lines.en: I walk forward through the shallows.
Each step sends the water wide.
My long gown trails on the surface.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，水珠跟着浮起。
lines.en: I raise a hand and droplets rise.
I pass the rock, going around.
I walk slowly along the shore.
The water parts at my feet.
I stop and look at the sea.
The wind moves my hem.
Done with the sea, I walk on.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方水面很平。
lines.en: The water is flat where I've walked.
Out of the shallows, I turn to the sand.
I stand in the shallows, very still.
Water-light shifts over me.
Water drips from my sleeve, one drop at a time.

lines.zh: 海风把我的头发吹起来。
lines.en: The sea wind lifts my hair.
In the shallows, I don't speak.
Silent, I listen to the tide.
It comes up, again and again.
There's salt in the sea wind; I can smell it.
The sea is shallow here.
The sea is shallow, but deep enough for me.
After a while, I open my eyes.
A school of fish passes my feet.
The school comes. I don't move.
They circle and come back.
From the sand, I turn to you.
You stand on the sand.
I raise a hand in greeting.
My gown spreads in the water.
You come a little closer.
I wait for you to come nearer.
The water parts at your feet.
You come closer. I lower my eyes.
Eyes lowered, I take your measure.
My measure taken: you mean no harm.

lines.zh: 看出你没恶意，我才抬眼。
lines.en: No malice in you. I raise my eyes.
No malice, then. Good.
Good. I hold out a hand.

lines.zh: 我把手递出，你尽可过来。
lines.en: I hold out a hand. You may come.
Come. The water won't hurt you.

lines.zh: 它不会伤你，这话我担保。
lines.en: It won't hurt you. I promise.

lines.zh: 我一退，踩碎了脚边的水。
lines.en: One step back and the water splashes.
A tear opens in my gown.

lines.zh: 裙摆撕开一道，我没有叫。
lines.en: A tear in my gown. I make no sound.
A thin film of water seals the wound.
The water-light dims.

lines.zh: 水面上的光暗了，我挺直身子。
lines.en: The water-light dims. I straighten up.
The tide is as it was.

lines.zh: 潮水照旧涨落，你确实伤到了我。
lines.en: The tide is unchanged. You did hurt me.
I remember that feeling.

lines.zh: 你伤到我了，但我不会退。
lines.en: You hurt me. But I won't retreat.
Is that seafood?
I can smell it. Seafood.
I smell it and reach out.
As I take it, gently.
Gently, I eat slowly.
I eat slowly. It's good.
This is good. Any more?
It's all right if not.
I can find my own in the sea.
Keep this shell for yourself.

lines.zh: 留给自己也行，我谢过你。
lines.en: Keep some too, if you like. I thank you.

lines.zh: 我向你道了谢，这很少见。
lines.en: I thank you. I rarely do.
You bump me and the water splashes.
The sand sinks half an inch under me.
My gown is wet through.

lines.zh: 裙角湿了一大片，我并不恼。
lines.en: My hem is soaked. I'm not angry.
I shake the water from my hand.

lines.zh: 抖掉手上的水，你退了半步。
lines.en: I shake the water off. You step back.

lines.zh: 你后撤少许，彼此皆安然。
lines.en: You ease back. Both of us are fine.
Both fine. Gentler next time.

lines.zh: 下回脚下留神，海不怨你。
lines.en: Slower next time. The sea won't blame you.

lines.zh: 海水不会记恨，我也不会。
lines.en: The sea bears no grudge. Nor do I.
Digimon grow by evolving.
I'm at the Ultimate level.
Beyond that is unknown.
I stand here and wait.
I stand here. The sea is always here.

lines.zh: 我抬手招引，水珠离了海面。
lines.en: I raise a hand and droplets lift off the sea.
Droplets rise, then fall.
I have plenty of time.

lines.zh: 我不缺时间，潮水也不缺。
lines.en: I have plenty of time. So does the tide.
We wait for each other.
I bend and lift it from the water.
I lift a shell from the shallows.

lines.zh: 贝壳里的纹路一圈套一圈。
lines.en: The shell's rings circle one inside another.
Held up, the pattern is lovely.
A lovely pattern. I tuck it away.
Water drips from the cuff.

lines.zh: 袖口滴着水，我接着前行。
lines.en: Water drips from my cuff. I walk on.
There are many more on the sand.
I'll keep only this one.

lines.zh: 沙上还散着许多，一枚就够。
lines.en: Many more on the sand. One is enough.
Something moves on the water.
Something stirs. I look up.
Palm up, and the water stands.
Water rises from the sea.
It gathers into a sphere before my palm.
That's not something I know.
I flick a fingertip and the drops form a line.

lines.zh: 我把它送出去，水球飞向那边。
lines.en: I push it out and the sphere flies.
The sphere flies. It dodges.

lines.zh: 更多的水升起来，我锁住它。
lines.en: More water rises. I've marked it.

lines.zh: 礁石也在范围里，我开始念。
lines.en: The rock is in my reach too. I begin the invocation.

lines.zh: 可也能伤人，我准备好了。
lines.en: But it can wound as well. I'm ready.
It's behind the rock.

lines.zh: 它躲在礁石后，我不急着追。
lines.en: It's behind the rock. I won't hurry.
I let the water spread.
It retreats higher.
I raise a hand and the water follows.

lines.zh: 我把水放过去，它逃上沙滩。
lines.en: I let the water spread. It runs up the sand.
It runs up the sand. I walk over.

lines.zh: 裙摆扫过湿沙，它举起武器。
lines.en: My gown sweeps the wet sand. It raises a weapon.
Water draws into a line.

lines.zh: 水凝成一条线，它勉强挡住。
lines.en: Water draws into a line. It barely blocks.
The line breaks. Thicker this time.

lines.zh: 水线加粗一分，它便退开。
lines.en: Thicker now, and it retreats.
The water in my palm bursts outward.

lines.zh: 我一掌送出，水柱直冲过去。
lines.en: One palm out, and the column strikes.
The jet drives it back.
The water gathers again. The technique unfolds.
Light and water mingle.

lines.zh: 光与水搅在一处，它硬接下来。
lines.en: Light and water churn. It takes the hit.
I add a little force.
Its armor begins to crack.

lines.zh: 它的甲片开始崩，我便收势。
lines.en: Its armor starts to split. I draw back.

lines.zh: 我收手之后，它还在站着。
lines.en: I draw back, and it's still standing.

lines.zh: 算我输了这一手，我退了半步。
lines.en: I concede this round. I step back.
Half a step back. Until next time.
I walk up out of the sea.
Water runs down my gown.
My feet settle on the wet sand.
The wind lays my hair across my cheek.

lines.zh: 我踏着湿沙，把手举了起来。
lines.en: On the wet sand, I raise a hand.
Droplets lift from my fingers.
This sea is quiet.
Footsteps on the shore.
Someone is watching me.
Wading the shallows, I walk over.

lines.zh: 我一步步走近，然后站定。
lines.en: I walk over slowly and stop.
I stop. Don't be afraid.

lines.zh: 火在海面上烧，烧断了我的裙边。
lines.en: Fire burns on the sea and singes my hem.
I fall and the water catches me.

lines.zh: 我就是从海里来的，却也会沉。
lines.en: I came from the sea, yet I can sink.

lines.zh: 冲击把水推开，露出沙底。
lines.en: The blast shoves the water aside, baring sand.

lines.zh: 弹丸掠过水面，擦过我的肩。
lines.en: A round skims the water and grazes my shoulder.
Two techniques collide.
I rarely eat, but I can run empty.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，水把它带走了。
lines.en: Lightning falls and the water carries it away.
The water's gone and I keep walking down.
